text.p: U.S. mining company Cyprus Amax Minerals said its lithium prices have dropped by around $0.30 to $0.40 a pound as a result of a sharp rise in world lithium production this year.
"Prices have fallen to an average $1.05...a 30 to 40 cent drop," said chief finance officer Gerald Malys.
Despite the fall in prices, Cyprus has maintained its Chilean and Nevada lithium operations working at top capacity, he told a news conference.
World lithium prices have tumbled following a decision by Chilean fertilizer-maker Soquimich to sell lithium from its new Minsal mine at 30 percent below market prices.
Minsal, which has capacity to produce 40 million pounds of lithium a year, came on line late in 1996.
Minsal officials have said their aim is to stimulate world demand for the mineral by cutting prices and breaking the market dominance of Cyprus and FMC Corp -- the only other large lithium producers.
Largest consumers of lithium carbonate, a fine white powder, are the glass, ceramics and primary aluminium industries.
It is also used, in much smaller quantities, in pharmaceuticals as a well-known treatment for manic depression.
